prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. The frame is folded down the middle like a mirror, the seam a crisp vertical line: the two men are exact mirror images of each other, the same face, the same build and the same pose, one in a red scarf on the left and one in a blue scarf on the right. Camera close behind them at hip height as they stand nose to nose, shouting: in each back trouser pocket, the same thin brown pay envelope. Their faces in profile above, both red and furious, a broad nose, grey stubble and a chipped front tooth. Light: a gas lamp above them, rain on their caps, the wet street behind carrying the lamp in streaks. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
